versions.content: ECU configuration is not suitable to be exchanged between partners in an ECU development project The ECU configuration (EcuC) parameters defined by the AUTOSAR Software Specification (SWS) documents for Dem and Dcm are not suitable to be exchanged between partners in an ECU development project. Besides proprietary ways of using the EcuC format, the main reason for EcuC param- eters being inappropriate to be exchanged is their closeness to implementation (e.g. parameter on buffer sizes).
